integrity.computational_evidence: Reproducible checks of all eighteen types over F25, F121, F289 and F625; not an external certification.
integrity.mathematical_evidence: Derivation from maximal Hermitian quotients and the eight weights of tame first cohomology.
integrity.scope_of_claim: eight distinct zeta numerators across eighteen diagonal scaling classes for every p congruent to 5 modulo 6

scientific_limitations: Only curves of the explicit canonical diagonal family are classified, not all genus-four curves or all arithmetic twists.
Eighteen types are diagonal coefficient-scaling types, not eighteen asserted nonisomorphic curves.
Uniform proof uses the Hermitian quotient and tame character decomposition; finite counts provide checks only.
The final 2019 journal full text was not inspected, and priority against fully general Jacobi-sum formulae is a residual risk.
title: Eight Weil-polynomial types in a diagonal genus-four family
